evidence.summary: Absolute elevations cannot be compared across planetary bodies.
evidence.detail: Candidate datum: EGM96 geoid (mean sea level = 0 m). Target datum: Gravitational areoid — equipotential surface at ~6.1 mbar pressure level. MOLA total vertical uncertainty ≥ 3 m; LOLA ≤ 1 m.

similarities.summary: Shared geological class(es): plains_and_lowlands. Candidate: Hyper-arid high plateau with ignimbrite volcanic plateau, alluvial fans, and salt flats (salares). Atacama: Rech et al. 2010; Evenstar et al. 2017.. Landforms: Volcanic plateau (puna), Alluvial fan, Playa / salar, Canyon scarp, Desert pavement. Target: Jezero Crater: ancient lacustrine delta deposit in a Noachian impact basin. Surrounded by highland volcanic basalt. USGS Geologic Map of Mars (Tanaka et al. 2014); Farley et al. 2022 (Perseverance).. Landforms: Ancient river delta, Crater floor, Impact rim escarpment, Basaltic volcanic terrain.
similarities.detail: Draft crosswalk built from USGS map group names only (Fortezzo et al. 2020; Tanaka et al. 2014). Confidence: moderate. Full unit descriptions not yet verified.

mismatches.summary: Earth Atacama shows aeolian deflation and trace evaporite alteration (gypsum, halite). Target surface has no atmospheric weathering — only micrometeorite comminution (Moon) or aeolian perchlorate chemistry (Mars). Earth soil is weathered; target regolith is pristine or reactive.

evidence.summary: Rock abundance data not yet ingested for any body.
evidence.detail: Moon: Diviner GDR Level 3 Rock Abundance (60°S–60°N, 32 ppd) not ingested. Mars: THEMIS thermal inertia not ingested. Earth: no rock abundance product confirmed.

evidence.summary: Mineralogical indicator data not yet ingested for any body.
evidence.detail: Moon: Diviner Christiansen Feature position not ingested. Mars: TES mineral maps (4 ppd, ~16 km) not ingested. Earth: no spectral mineral product confirmed.

mismatches.summary: Direct cross-body temperature comparison is NOT COMPARABLE: Earth has a 1,013 hPa convective atmosphere; Mars ~6 hPa CO₂; Moon is hard vacuum. Thermal physics, atmospheric buffering, and local solar time sampling differ fundamentally.

evidence.summary: Surface temperature data not available for candidate or target.
evidence.detail: Earth land surface temperature product (ECOSTRESS / MODIS MOD11A2) not yet ingested — requires NASA Earthdata credentials. THEMIS: ASU THEMIS Day IR mosaics are 8-bit PNG image tiles with no temperature units or calibration scale factor — they are pictures, not numeric measurements.

evidence.summary: Day/night temperature pair not available for candidate or target.
evidence.detail: No calibrated numeric Mars day/night temperature pair available. ASU THEMIS Day IR mosaics are 8-bit PNG image tiles with no temperature units or calibration scale factor — they are pictures, not numeric measurements. Published sanity value: Jezero ~−83°C before dawn, ~+5°C at noon (NASA MEDA).

evidence.summary: Thermal inertia data not yet ingested for any body.
evidence.detail: MGS TES thermal inertia binary (nmap2003.bin + interpolation mask) not yet ingested. Reader implemented in src/processing/pds_reader.py but file not present on disk. USGS 8-bit THEMIS mosaic is qualitative only. When ingested, compare only as ordered classes with interpolation mask applied.

uncertainties: Resolution disparity is the dominant uncertainty: candidate at 180 m/px captures sub-km terrain; target at 14.8 km/px averages landscape-scale features.
Target grid (10×10 = 100 pixels) is too coarse for distribution comparison. Summary statistics used as reference bounds.
All thermal and mineralogical parameters are INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE — pending dataset ingestion.
Geological crosswalk is a draft built from map group names only. Full unit descriptions have not been verified.

limitations.impact: Slope stability, avalanche dynamics, and rover traction differ fundamentally. Equal slope angles are NOT equally hazardous across bodies.
No convective heat dissipation, no liquid water stability, no atmospheric pressure on suits or habitats.

limitations.target: Elevated UV and cosmic-ray flux; thin CO₂ atmosphere offers minimal shielding
limitations.impact: Surface habitats require regolith berming or sub-surface siting. No Earth analogue preparation addresses this.

limitations.earth: Active microbial, hydro-chemical, and aeolian weathering
limitations.target: Aeolian dust transport; toxic perchlorate (ClO₄⁻) chemistry; no liquid water
limitations.impact: Earth regolith contains organic binders. Target body regolith is mechanically abrasive or chemically hazardous.
